description: Montana Senate leaders are drafting a flat income tax for the 2027 session. Most households in the Billings Heights already pay Montana's lowest income tax rate, so a flat tax would either pass us by entirely or raise what we owe. Before anyone votes on it, I want one question answered: where does the money come from?
